candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: BDUK values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.transition_metric: June-to-July deltas, ratios, ranks, shares, contributions and classifications are deterministic calculations over displayed rounded values and displayed totals. Scope revisions, resubmissions and ingestion timing can drive movement; these metrics are not official statistics, forecasts, supplier-performance verdicts or parcel-level claims.
scope_guards.cross_section_metric: July shares and ranks are deterministic calculations over the displayed rounded table and total. Ties use competition ranking; these are not official rankings or exact-address availability claims.
scope_guards.coverage_scope: Connected Nations figures are national or aggregate snapshots using stated methodologies and dates; they do not prove availability, performance or eligibility at a specific address.
scope_guards.scam_scope: Ofcom scam guidance provides precautionary and reporting steps; it does not prove that a specific contact is fraudulent or determine legal liability.
scope_guards.checker_scope: Map Your Mobile is an indicative comparison tool using crowdsourced and predictive data; actual reception can vary by device, building, terrain, time and precise location.
scope_guards.switch_scope: 2G/3G switch-off guidance describes announced sector transitions; actual impact, timing and support depend on network, device, service and customer circumstances.
